quotes.text: And that, to me, is an agentic developer these days is more, in a sense, more of a supervisor than an actual coder, but we're still, we still need to have that technical knowledge. We still need to know how the pieces work.
quotes.speaker: Nick Doelman
quotes.why: Defines the changing role of the developer in agentic coding as a supervisor who still needs deep technical knowledge.

quotes.text: I think a lot of that prompting is also evolving into using those prompts to build reusable skills. So when I say reusable skills, I'm not talking about the skills that we have as developers, but the skills that we give to our agents.
quotes.speaker: Nick Doelman
quotes.why: Explains how prompt engineering is evolving into building reusable agent skills.

quotes.text: But overall, dataverse in a sense to me is really the core of the business system because at the end of the day, you still need to store your information somewhere.
quotes.speaker: Nick Doelman
quotes.why: States clearly why Dataverse remains central to business applications in an agentic world.

quotes.text: There's been a couple news articles over the years of data, data leaks involving power pages. And in both instances, it was not a fault of power pages. It was actually a fault of how it was configured.
quotes.speaker: Nick Doelman
quotes.why: Puts Power Pages security incidents into perspective as configuration problems rather than platform flaws.

quotes.text: And a lot of the other things too is when if you try to get AI to do something for you six months ago, try it again. You might be surprised.
quotes.speaker: Nick Doelman
quotes.why: Practical advice to regularly retest AI tools because their capabilities change quickly.

Advice: keep experimenting and load Visual Studio Code

takeaways: Agentic coding works best like pair programming: start with a plan and a product requirements document, generate prompts from it and supervise the agent's output with real technical knowledge.

Power Platform makers should start working in Visual Studio Code with tools such as the Dataverse MCP server, agent skills, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, while Dataverse remains the governed data core.
Customers should keep control of prompts, skills and agent-generated documentation alongside their source code, and organizations should retest AI tools regularly because capabilities change fast.
hook: AI coding agents are changing how Power Platform solutions are designed, built and maintained. In this conversation, Microsoft MVP and MCT Nick Doelman explains to makers, developers and consultants what agentic coding really means in practice. You learn how to combine Visual Studio Code, Dataverse and coding agents productively without giving up governance and control.
